meta.name: The Detour
meta.description: A what-in-the-living-hell-is-wrong-with-this-family comedy created by comic super-couple Jason Jones & Samantha Bee and inspired by their own experiences with family trips. Unfiltered dad Nate hits the road with wife Robin and kids Delilah and Jared. Every leg of their trip is fraught with disaster as they encounter one hellish turn after another. If there's trouble on the road, this family will find it and plow into it.

videos.title: The Hotel
videos.overview: Having driven their van, 'Blue Thunder', into a ditch, it has to be repaired over-night. The Parkers stay at a nearby motel, Swift Stay Suites. What could possibly go right?

videos.title: The Tank
videos.overview: The Parkers are barely back on the road when Nate gets pulled over for driving under the influence. He's completely sober but somehow there's still some jail time involved.

videos.title: The Restaurant
videos.overview: Back on the road, the Parkers begrudgingly stop to eat at a nauseatingly, culturally insensitive, roadside restaurant and dinner theater called Conquistadors.

videos.title: The B & B
videos.overview: While the kids recover from acute food poisoning, the Parkers decide to get some rest at a southern B&B. They are treated to southern hospitality, southern customs and Russian vodka.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Instead of getting back on the road, Robin agrees to marry the southern gentleman Dr. Rob and his Russian bride but soon realizes that something is very, very, very, very wrong.

videos.title: The Road
videos.overview: Blue Thunder is stuck in traffic. Nate and Robin take a stroll down memory lane about how they met and the kids learn an important lesson in 'too much information'. Seriously. Too much. Stop.

videos.title: The Drop
videos.overview: Nate needs to take a detour to Salvation, Florida where it's Christmas every day of the year - except on Christmas. Things get tense when the family discovers that Nate has been lying to them.

videos.title: The Track
videos.overview: The Parkers finally make it to Ft. Lauderdale only to have Nate's plan of getting his job back completely unravel. Fortunately, at a nearby race track, there is hope.

videos.title: The Beach
videos.overview: Nate, Robin and the kids attempt to take down Nate's company in epic whistle blowing fashion. It won't be easy, but if there's one thing we've learned about this family is that they don't give up without at least a punch to the throat and maybe a cheap kick to the groin.

videos.title: The City
videos.overview: Nate is offered a new job in New York City, so the family moves from Syracuse to the Big Apple. Robin isn't thrilled about the idea. And of course, getting there will be way harder than it should be.

videos.title: The Club
videos.overview: Robin's ex Carlos lures her back into their wild past with a visit to the club where they used to party, and Nate gets jealous. The kids meet Nate's new boss.

videos.title: The Tub
videos.overview: As Nate and Robin contemplate having another baby, a neighbor's casual get-together turns into a home birth. And Delilah learns what it means to be a third wheel.

videos.title: The Court
videos.overview: Robin attempts to get a divorce from Carlos, but he has other ideas. She's also forced to come clean about her past in the city.

videos.title: The Birth
videos.overview: Ever wondered what happened the night the twins were born? Here's a taste: Halloween, drunk Nate, unhappy Robin and Gene dressed as Napoleon Dynamite.

videos.title: The Heat
videos.overview: The Parkers settle into a seemingly normal New York City routine, but they're being surveilled by Federal agents who see much more than they intended to.

videos.title: The Job
videos.overview: Faced with the threat of losing his job, Nate tries to land a new customer and brings the family along.

videos.title: The Dilemma
videos.overview: Her past finally having caught up with her, Robin prepares to go away for a long time. Nate tries to piece together what went wrong and Delilah and Jared make the most of their school talent show.

videos.title: The Trip
videos.overview: New York to Florida in a janky van? This sounds familiar. But this time there's no stopping as Robin and Nate make record time to get to the kids.

videos.title: The Mule
videos.overview: Robin and Nate live out their (mostly Nate's) action movie fantasies as they make their way to the kids, who are actually doing just fine without them.

videos.title: The Run
videos.overview: After a year on the lam across the continental US, the Parkers finally settle into the last place anyone will be looking for them. Alaska. But their lies and deceits soon come back to haunt them.

videos.title: The Stop
videos.overview: Nate tries to navigate his new role as stay-at-home dad. Between the kids hitting puberty and Robin’s long work hours and incessant partying, he’s managing. Kind of.

videos.title: The Mark
videos.overview: Edie continues to surveil the Parkers and is looking for the stupidest member of the family to get close to. Fortunately for her, she's got a lot of choices.

videos.title: The Boat
videos.overview: With Robin out of work, its Nate's turn to earn-- on an Alaskan factory fishing trawler. But it's only 7 months of rotting fish, meth fumes, and family separation. What could go wrong?

videos.title: The Vows
videos.overview: Upon returning home from a winter at sea, Nate is left at the dock by his family. After a lift back to his "life"in town, he soon realizes things change fast. And he's not sure he likes it. Actually, he really hates it.

videos.title: The Water
videos.overview: A look back at Robin and Nate's first vacation together. A trip to the tropics and their first time alone since the kids were born. Spoiler Alert. They have an awful time.

videos.title: The Plane
videos.overview: Nate reunites with his family and pulls off an evacuation away from Edie and the feds, but they have to rely on a terminally ill, 90-year-old Alaskan bush pilot.

videos.title: The Funeral
videos.overview: Having crashed their plane into the Alaskan wilderness the family must rely on one another to survive. It's like the Revenant. But less cold and grunting.

videos.title: The Escape
videos.overview: The Parkers finally happen upon help in an abandoned ghost town which is filled with deadly serious Pacific Rim LARPERS.

videos.title: The Search
videos.overview: The Parkers embark on a world-wide search to find their runaway daughter Delilah.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Following a breakthrough, the Parkers return to their hometown to find their daughter.

videos.title: The Sister
videos.overview: Nate and Robin head to Ithaca expecting to find their daughter but find a new family member instead.

videos.title: The B.J.
videos.overview: Nate gets caught in the worst “parent trap” ever.

videos.title: The Year
videos.overview: Delilah and Jared reunite and catch up on the past year.

videos.title: The Game Show
videos.overview: The Parkers go on a Japanese Game Show.

videos.title: The Entertainer
videos.overview: Jared comes up with a morbid plan to reunite the family.

videos.title: The Same
videos.overview: Nate and Robin chase their kids around the world.

videos.title: The Bride
videos.overview: In order to save his family Nate ends up on a Russian bride tour.

videos.title: The Groom
videos.overview: Nate finally gets married to save his family.
